Ajith Kumar, the Indian actor known for his passion in motorsports, has purchased a highly coveted Mahindra BE 6 Formula E car worth ₹24 lakh after returning to India. The event was marked by visits to the iconic Sri Sai Baba temple and recognition from Mahindra as they present the world's first 'Formula E' themed SUV.

A scene depicting Ajith Kumar arriving at a bustling Indian city, surrounded by people admiring his car, with the iconic Sri Sai Baba temple in the background visible through a scenic window. The image is reminiscent of post-movie or television scenes set against a backdrop of vibrant Indian culture and spirituality.
